description: Update a service. Partial update. Any content change re-embeds; changing only active does not. The service image is never touched by the API.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code such as USD or EUR. Null means the account default.

is_virtual.description: Bookings get a Google Meet link. Honoured only when Google Calendar is connected and Meet is on.

price.description: Optional. Leave empty when there is no set price; it is never shown to customers as 0 or free. Dropped when price_unit is free or quote.

price_unit.description: free marks a service as free; quote means the price is given on request.

name: update_service
